name: TeamStarWolf - E-Commerce Threats: The Public Record, 1999 to 2026
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK techniques that the verified e-commerce threat record of 1999 to 2026 supports: the DOJ Gonzalez ring charges, US-CERT TA14-212A on Backoff, the Home Depot and Target records, the ICO penalty notices on British Airways and Ticketmaster UK, ATT&CK's FIN6 procedures, the KEV and NVD records for Adobe Commerce and Magento, and Reported vendor research on the Magento waves, polyfill.io and Convertr. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/ECOMMERCE_THREATS.md. Scores: 100 a Confirmed primary or ATT&CK's own FIN6 procedures describe the behavior; 60 the behavior is known only from Reported vendor research; 40 the id choice itself stretches the record. Except where the ATT&CK page carries the procedure, the mappings are this study's reading.

legendItems.label: 40: the id choice stretches the record (Inferred)
100: a Confirmed primary or ATT&CK's FIN6 procedures

Obfuscated Files or Information: obfuscated JavaScript injected into CMS pages and blocks (30 Mar 2026, Reported) [30]; obfuscated and spoofed-analytics skimmers (Microsoft, May 2022, Reported) [45]. Source numbers refer to the Sources table of case-studies/ECOMMERCE_THREATS.md.

Credential Stuffing: more than 1.1 million accounts at 17 companies (NY OAG guide, undated) [46]; buy-now-pay-later account takeover (F5 Labs, Aug 2021, Reported) [55]; definition [111]. Source numbers refer to the Sources table of case-studies/ECOMMERCE_THREATS.md.

Local Data Staging: the library's ATT&CK mappings for RawPOS (S0169), FrameworkPOS (S0503) and PUNCHTRACK (S0197) [114]; tied to no named incident in this study (Inferred). Source numbers refer to the Sources table of case-studies/ECOMMERCE_THREATS.md.

Financial Theft: the CD Universe extortion demand (Dec 1999, Reported) [1] and the Gonzalez ring's ATM cash-out (DOJ, 2008) [4]; the ATT&CK page names no e-commerce or skimming case [112] (Inferred). Source numbers refer to the Sources table of case-studies/ECOMMERCE_THREATS.md.
